## Description
Please include a summary of the real-time feature, event streaming update, or socket bug fix.

Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes a socket/telemetry issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds WebSocket events or services)
- [ ] Breaking change (change in event payload contracts or handshake schema)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance / Redis scaling optimization

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the TypeScript style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have verified socket connection and room isolation locally
- [ ] I have made corresponding updates to README and sequence diagrams
- [ ] My changes pass type checking (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] I have added automated socket client tests (`npm test`)
- [ ] TypeScript compilation builds cleanly without warnings (`npm run build`)
